mapper.select: SELECT /* LGVATTO0010.retrievePortletATTSummary */ ar.time_and_attendance_yyyymm, TO_CHAR(ar.normal_working_days ) AS normal_working_days, TO_CHAR(ar.normal_working_hours) AS normal_working_hours, TO_CHAR(ar.ot_weekday_hours ) AS ot_weekday_hours, TO_CHAR(ar.ot_holiday_hours ) AS ot_holiday_hours, TO_CHAR(ar.ot_public_hours ) AS ot_public_hours, TO_CHAR(ar.lateness_hours ) AS lateness_hours, TO_CHAR(ar.leaving_early_hours ) AS leaving_early_hours, TO_CHAR(ar.going_out_hours ) AS going_out_hours, TO_CHAR(aa.total_annual_days ) AS total_annual_days, TO_CHAR(aa.total_used_days ) AS total_used_days, TO_CHAR(aa.total_unused_days ) AS total_unused_days, TO_CHAR(aa.total_used_rate ) AS total_used_rate FROM ( SELECT MAX(ar.time_and_attendance_yyyymm) AS time_and_attendance_yyyymm, NVL(SUM(NVL(ac.attendance_days, 0) +NVL(ac.paid_days, 0) ), 0) AS normal_working_days, NVL(SUM(NVL(ac.attendance_days, 0) +NVL(ac.paid_days, 0) ), 0) * 8 AS normal_working_hours, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN ar.time_and_attendance_code NOT IN ( 'WH', 'PH' ) THEN ar.overtime_sum_hours ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS ot_weekday_hours, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN ar.time_and_attendance_code IN ( 'WH' ) THEN ar.overtime_sum_hours ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS ot_holiday_hours, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN ar.time_and_attendance_code IN ( 'PH' ) THEN ar.overtime_sum_hours ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS ot_public_hours, NVL(SUM(ar.tardy_hours), 0) AS lateness_hours, NVL(SUM(ar.early_leave_hours), 0) AS leaving_early_hours, NVL(SUM(ar.going_out_hours), 0) AS going_out_hours FROM tb_att_result_n ar, tb_att_code_c ac WHERE ar.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND ar.employee_no = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.employeeNo} AND ar.time_and_attendance_yyyymm = lgvatt_common_pkg.get_curr_att_yyyymm(#{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode}) AND ar.time_and_attendance_code = ac.time_and_attendance_code AND ar.subsidiary_code = ac.subsidiary_code ) ar, ( SELECT total_annual_days, total_used_days, NVL(total_annual_days - total_used_days, 0) AS total_unused_days, NVL(ROUND(DECODE(total_annual_days, 0, 0, total_used_days / total_annual_days * 100), 1), 0) AS total_used_rate FROM ( SELECT NVL(aa.total_annual_days, 0) + NVL(pa.residual_annual_leave_days, 0) AS total_annual_days, NVL(aa.total_used_days, 0) AS total_used_days FROM ( SELECT aa.employee_no, NVL(SUM(NVL(aa.occur_basic_annual_leave_days, 0) + NVL(aa.occur_monthly_ann_lv_days, 0)), 0) AS total_annual_days, NVL(SUM(aa.use_annual_leave_days), 0) AS total_used_days FROM tb_att_annual_leave_n aa WHERE aa.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND aa.employee_no = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.employeeNo} AND aa.time_and_attendance_yyyymm LIKE SUBSTR(lgvatt_common_pkg.get_curr_att_yyyymm(#{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode}), 1, 4) || '%' GROUP BY aa.employee_no ) aa, ( SELECT pa.employee_no, NVL(pa.residual_annual_leave_days, 0) AS residual_annual_leave_days FROM tb_att_annual_leave_n pa WHERE pa.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND pa.employee_no = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.employeeNo} AND pa.time_and_attendance_yyyymm = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(lgvatt_common_pkg.get_curr_att_yyyymm(#{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode}), 1, 4) || '12', 'YYYYMM'), -12), 'YYYYMM') /* 전년12월 */ ) pa WHERE aa.employee_no = pa.employee_no(+) ) ) aa WHERE 1 = 1
